title: Systematic Pharmacology and Experimental Validation to Reveal the Alleviation of Astragalus membranaceus Regulating Ferroptosis in Osteoarthritis.
authors: Chen, Kai; Yu, Yaohui; Wang, Yishu; Zhu, Yi; Qin, Chaoren; Xu, Jintao; Zou, Xiangjie; Tao, Tianqi; Li, Yang; Jiang, Yiqiu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄芪调节骨关节炎软骨细胞铁死亡，涉及分子对接但核心为药物-蛋白作用，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Astragalus membranaceus (AM) shows promise as a therapeutic agent for osteoarthritis (OA), a debilitating condition with high disability rates. OA exacerbation is linked to chondrocyte ferroptosis, yet the precise pharmacological mechanisms of AM remain unclear. METHODS: We validated AM's protective efficacy in an anterior cruciate ligament transection (ACLT) mouse model of OA. The Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database and Analysis Platform (TCMSP) database was utilized to identify AM's active components and their targets. FerrDb (a database for regulators and markers of ferroptosis and ferroptosis-disease associations) pinpointed ferroptosis-related targets, while GeneCards, Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man (OMIM), Pharmacogenomics Knowledgebase (PharmGKB), Therapeutic Target Database (TTD), and DrugBank sourced OA-related genes. Molecular docking analysis further validated these targets. Ultimately, the validation of the results was accomplished through in vitro experiments. RESULTS: AM exhibited anabolic effects and suppressed catabolism in OA chondrocytes. Network pharmacology identified 19 common genes, and molecular docking suggested quercetin, an AM constituent, interacts with key proteins like HO-1 and NRF2 to inhibit chondrocyte ferroptosis. In vitro experiments confirmed AM's ability to modulate the NRF2/HO-1 pathway via quercetin, mitigating chondrocyte ferroptosis. CONCLUSION: This study elucidates how AM regulates chondrocyte ferroptosis, impacting OA progression, providing a theoretical basis and experimental support for AM's scientific application.
abstract_zh: 背景：黄芪（Astragalus membranaceus, AM）在骨关节炎（osteoarthritis, OA）治疗中显示出潜力，OA是一种致残率高、令人衰弱的疾病。OA的恶化与软骨细胞铁死亡（ferroptosis）相关，但AM的确切药理机制尚不明确。方法：我们在前交叉韧带横断（ACLT）小鼠OA模型中验证了AM的保护功效。利用中药系统药理学数据库与分析平台（TCMSP）识别AM的活性成分及其靶点。FerrDb（铁死亡调控因子、标志物及铁死亡-疾病关联数据库）确定了铁死亡相关靶点，而GeneCards、在线人类孟德尔遗传数据库（OMIM）、药物基因组学知识库（PharmGKB）、治疗靶点数据库（TTD）和DrugBank则获取了OA相关基因。分子对接分析进一步验证了这些靶点。最终，通过体外实验完成了结果的验证。结果：AM在OA软骨细胞中表现出合成代谢效应并抑制分解代谢。网络药理学识别出19个共同基因，分子对接提示AM成分槲皮素（quercetin）与HO-1和NRF2等关键蛋白相互作用，抑制软骨细胞铁死亡。体外实验证实AM通过槲皮素调节NRF2/HO-1通路，减轻软骨细胞铁死亡。结论：本研究阐明了AM如何调节软骨细胞铁死亡，影响OA进展，为AM的科学应用提供了理论基础和实验支持。
